player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Minesweeper game.
Ee ciɛŋ ciɛŋ ee game ee rot loŋ ciɛŋ ee cel tɛ̈ɛ̈ ciɛŋ ee mines.
Bɛ̈ɛ̈n ee kɔc, bɛ̈ɛ̈n ee row ku column coordinates yɔ̈ɔ̈ ee cel ee rot loŋ ciɛŋ ee format:
- `[row col]`: Rot loŋ ciɛŋ ee cel ee tɛ̈ɛ̈ row ku column.
Kɔ̈ɔ̈ ee kɛ̈ɛ̈:
- `[3 2]` rot loŋ ciɛŋ ee cel ee Row 3, Column 2.
- `[5 6]` rot loŋ ciɛŋ ee cel ee Row 5, Column 6.
Ee kɔc yɔ̈ɔ̈, yɔ̈ɔ̈ ee rot loŋ ciɛŋ ee cel ee yɔ̈ɔ̈ ee kɔ̈ɔ̈ ee cel ee rot loŋ ciɛŋ ee safe start.
Ee board layout ee tɛ̈ɛ̈ ee kɔ̈ɔ̈ ee cel ee unrevealed ee represented ee dot ('.'), revealed numbers ee show ee count ee adjacent mines.
Bɛ̈ɛ̈n ee kɔ̈ɔ̈ ee cel ee already revealed.
Ee board layout ee tɛ̈ɛ̈ ee kɔ̈ɔ̈:

board.game_board: Ciɛrkä min la̱tkɛ kɛ kui̱ ŋarä: {board}
board.current_board: Kuär in tä thi̱n ɛn täämɛ: {board}

invalid_move.wrong_format: /Ka̱nɛ luɔc kɛ kɔrdiɛnti̱ni̱ ti̱ la thuɔ̱ɔ̱k rɛy kiɛɛr parɛkthi̱.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Kä röm in ca lat kɛnɛ köörɛnti̱ni̱ ɛ mi̱ /ci̱ rɔ lot.
invalid_move.already_revealed: Thok ke ye at ({row}, {col}) acɛ̈ɛ̈l kuɛ̈r.
invalid_move.hit_mine: Ya cɛ̈l kuɛ̈r thok ke kuɛ̈r at ({row}, {col}).

game_action.revealed: Ya cɛ̈l thok ke ye at ({row}, {col}).

outcome.win: Cää tɛth lɔaac, cia ji̱ luäk kɛ ɣöö bi minesweeper riali.
outcome.turn_limit: Kä cu pek in ca mat piny cop. Ji̱n ci jɛ luäŋ kɛ ɣöö biɛ ŋa̱c i̱ {percent}% kä thëlli̱ tin te gaŋkɛ ɛ jiek kɛn diaal.
